explanation: Kinematics are physical: eta-production threshold is W_thr = m_p + m_eta ~= 1.486 GeV, so W = 1.7 GeV is above threshold and within the eta-channel's supported grid (W: 1.487-2.211 GeV, Q^2: 0.3-5.0 GeV^2, |cos(theta*)| <= 0.9). The requested phi* = 370 deg is outside the conventional [0,360) deg range, so it was normalized to 10 deg (370 - 360 = 10) before writing the input file. In exclurad.F, phi* (phicm) only ever enters through cos()/sin() (e.g. lines 105/108, 4842-4844), which are 360-degree periodic, so this normalization is a purely cosmetic fix with no effect on the computed cross sections/radiative corrections. Wrote a single-point (N=1) EXCLURAD eta-configuration input file (model=3 maid2000/EtaMAID, ivec=1 recoil proton, bmom=6.53 GeV CLAS12, vcut=0.166 GeV^2) with W=1.7, Q2=1.0, cos(theta*)=0.5, phi*=10 deg.
